README.txt.content:
--------------------
Level 1
--------------------You have just arrived at your room at the IIT Ropar campus. As you plop down on your bed to take a well-deserved Insta break, you suddenly remember that you still haven't completed your physical registration in Auditorium yet. 'Registration karni jaruri hoti hai kya', you think to yourself, and open Instagram on your phone. But, to your surprise, there is no cellular data in your room and you don't know the wifi password. Unwillingly, you get up from your bed and go out to find the wi-fi password to resume your scrolling.

Find the IIT Ropar wi-fi password and pass it as the argument for the 'next' command to advance to the next level.

Useful Commands:
- cd
 -ls
